rules: Label only what the website states. No outside knowledge. Copy quotes exactly. If pages disagree, record both as conflicting. If the site does not say, use not_found.
review_notes: rentec.com is a deliberately minimal/opaque public site (typical for Renaissance): it never names any of its funds (e.g. Medallion), never names clients/investors, and gives no pricing/fee figures anywhere in the crawlable public pages. Two office addresses appear on the Careers page: '600 Route 25A, East Setauket, New York 11733' (Renaissance Technologies LLC) and '520 Madison Avenue, New York, New York 10022' (Renaissance Institutional Management LLC) -- the East Setauket address was used as the headquarters value since it is the firm's long-standing primary/main office per the site's own listing order, but this is a judgment call given both are listed as formal registered addresses. A footer link to 'SBAI' (Standards Board for Alternative Investments) exists on the site but its exact link text/context could not be confirmed verbatim, so it was NOT recorded as a partnership -- flagged for human re-check. products.names is not_found because the site names no specific investment products/funds at all. B-51 (2026-09-27): customers.segments' value added 'qualified', 'private fund offerings' and 'not the general public' qualifiers not literally present in the quote -- the evidence quote itself was already correct and unchanged, but the value has been tightened to 'Appropriate investors', tracking only what the quote actually says ('appropriate investors').
